parallelScoringPr.semanticBoundary: PR #475 keeps ScoringDispatcher as the sole productive scoring execution authority. PR #474 does not alter scoring routing, model registry, ranking, Universe SLA or canonical enrichment.

authorityCorrections: Removed provisional AsyncExecutionPort because ADR-0054 already owns generic durable job queue/retry/handler dispatch.

Removed proposed durable system_event_journal persistence because public.security_events and ADR-0059 already own durable security/audit evidence; bounded operational telemetry is intentionally ephemeral under ADR-0037.
Retired manual system-event creation and SSE compatibility surface so operational state remains runtime-derived and authenticated UI consumers do not fabricate compliance/audit evidence.
Reclassified the legacy Event Mesh SystemAuditEvent name as non-authorizing operational telemetry and removed actor/IP PII from that bridge.
Kept the Systemadmin execution host separate: it governs Owner-authorized repository mutations and cannot be replaced or bypassed by the ADR-0054 background-job drain.
correlation.finding: The value chain now reuses distinct canonical authorities for governance, scoring, durable background jobs, security events, agent audit, privacy retention, Systemadmin mutations and in-process telemetry without a second control plane.

externalMutationScope: none; this work item now introduces no Supabase schema migration and performs no Render, Supabase, Stripe or IAM production mutation
releaseCondition: Release after stacked PR merge/closure/supersession/abandonment. A future Render Workflows pilot requires a separate Owner-authorized production handoff and may only host the existing ADR-0054 outbox drain; it cannot own queue, retry, lease, dead-letter, domain-routing or Systemadmin mutation semantics.
